purpose: Cover the delta-detection primitives (hashDocument, computeTreeHash, computeDelta) and the freeze record I/O (load, save, validate) against AC-17201-1..4 on US-17201.
title: Delta detection and freeze record primitives

testCases.description: computeDelta returns the shape proposal section 2.2 pins: frozen / frozenAt / treeHash / currentTreeHash / changed / added / removed / briefSince / unchanged, and classifies changed / added / removed correctly against a divergent freeze record.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/delta.test.js::delta: changed / added / removed classify against the freeze record

testCases.description: A tree that matches the freeze record produces empty changed / added / removed lists and unchanged equal to the docHashes count.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/delta.test.js::delta: an unchanged tree against a matching freeze reports empty changed/added/removed

testCases.description: hashDocument is invariant under a whitespace-only reformat: two documents that parse to the same object hash identically and produce zero changed entries in the delta.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/delta.test.js::delta: a whitespace-only reformat of a document produces zero changed ids

testCases.description: hashDocument returns a sha256:<64-hex> string over the canonical JSON form of the parsed document.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/delta.test.js::delta: hashDocument returns a sha256:<64-hex> string over the canonical form

testCases.description: loadFreezeRecord returns null when rcf/define/freeze.json is absent; a malformed body raises FreezeRecordError with the parseFailure code.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/freeze-record.test.js::freeze-record: a malformed JSON body raises FreezeRecordError with parseFailure code

testCases.description: A body with a non-sha256 docHashes value is refused with a FreezeRecordError naming the failing docHashes.<id> field.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/freeze-record.test.js::freeze-record: docHashes with a non-sha256 value is refused

testCases.description: saveFreezeRecord followed by loadFreezeRecord round-trips every field including unknown extension fields (counts, litmus, versions, note).
testCases.testPointer: test/define/freeze-record.test.js::freeze-record: unknown top-level fields survive a save/load round trip

testCases.description: saveFreezeRecord refuses an invalid record and writes nothing to disk.
testCases.testPointer: test/define/freeze-record.test.js::freeze-record: saveFreezeRecord refuses to write an invalid record
